verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform, so auto-generating per-release changelogs is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents a changelog or release-notes generator. Linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, scheduled status and performance reports, and custom agents built from a description are adjacent features or building blocks, not a per-release changelog capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
